incident: CISA #StopRansomware: Interlock (AA25-203A, 22 July 2025) — technique chain, no named victim

sources.title: CISA/FBI/HHS/MS-ISAC Joint Advisory AA25-203A: #StopRansomware: Interlock
sources.what_it_gave: full ATT&CK chain: drive-by (T1189) / ClickFix (T1204.004) -> PowerShell (T1059.001) -> Run-key persistence (T1547.001) -> Cobalt Strike / SystemBC / Interlock RAT / NodeSnake C2 -> cht.exe (T1555.003), klg.dll keylogger (T1056.001), Kerberoasting (T1558.003) -> RDP (T1021.001), AnyDesk/PuTTY (T1219), PsExec -> Azure Storage Explorer (T1530) / AzCopy (T1567.002) / WinSCP (T1048) exfiltration -> AES+RSA encryption incl. ESXi (T1486), note via GPO, double extortion (T1657). No dwell time, no detection moment, no victim names, no sector breakdown.

sources.title: BleepingComputer: Kettering Health confirms Interlock ransomware (May 2025)
sources.what_it_gave: a real healthcare victim (charting, call centre, MyChart down; 941 GB claimed) but no public entry point, hop or detection moment

narrative_before: The advisory documents the Interlock chain seen since September 2024 (drive-by fake browser/VPN-client updates and ClickFix lures, Cobalt Strike/Interlock RAT, Kerberoasting, RDP/AnyDesk lateral movement, Azure Storage Explorer exfiltration, encryption including ESXi hosts). Kettering Health (Ohio, May 2025) is a confirmed healthcare victim, but neither the advisory nor Kettering published the entry host, a lateral hop or the detection moment.
ambiguities: The advisory describes a technique chain, not a victim network. Rule 4 of the pre-registration forbids invented links, and rule 5 needs a documented detection moment; neither can be satisfied from the advisory.

A first attempt to model a 'representative healthcare victim' from the advisory was abandoned: it would have been a synthetic network written by the converter, which is exactly what v11 exists to avoid.

CISA AA26-222A (Gunra, Aug 2026) was checked through secondary summaries: Fortinet CVE-2024-55591 / CVE-2025-24472 and VPN-credential entry, Impacket/SMB, NTDS dumping, MEGA exfiltration; names no victims either.
drop_reason: AA25-203A names no victim network, no lateral hop between identified hosts and no detection moment; modelling a synthetic victim would violate the 'no invented links' rule. Kettering Health (May 2025) is a real Interlock healthcare victim but has no public entry point or hop.
